title: Search systemd units by name pattern
summary: Find systemd units whose names match a specific pattern. This is useful for locating services or components related to a specific application or subsystem.

steps.explain: Provide a glob pattern (e.g., 'systemd*') as an argument to filter units by name.

placeholders.name: PATTERN
placeholders.description: A glob pattern to match unit names, e.g., 'nginx*' or 'systemd*'.

steps.expect: A list of units whose names match the pattern.
